description:
Local OpenAI-compatible router that aggregates free LLM providers.

FreeLLMAPI aggregates the free tiers of dozens of LLM providers, plus custom OpenAI-compatible chat, embedding, image, and audio endpoints, behind a single /v1 API.

A router picks the best available model for each request, falls over to the next provider when one is rate-limited, and tracks per-key usage so you stay under every free-tier cap. Provider keys are stored encrypted, and the router refreshes its model catalog from a signed feed. Built for personal use only; each provider's terms of service apply.
New providers
- Typecast: native SSFM 3.1, 3.0 and 2.1 text-to-speech.
- Cartesia: Sonic 3.6, 3.5 and 3 speech, plus Ink Whisper batch transcription.
- SilvR AI: OpenAI-compatible chat with normal and streaming model-identity checks.
The new providers appear in local key setup/import. Typecast Free output is non-commercial and requires attribution; Cartesia's commercial-use license is on a paid plan. Free allowances are shared account pools, not credits per model.
Native speech adapters preserve error/backoff information for failover, refuse credential redirects, bound downloads and validate actual audio / transcription responses. Chat cannot accidentally route to a speech model. This release also includes the recent URL-guard, Hugging Face video-download and request-lease fixes already merged into main.
Model rows are delivered separately through the signed catalog. Premium receives updates immediately; Free receives them after the existing 30-day aging rule. Mistral and local disabled choices are unchanged.
